image_hypothesis: Folded interferometric coupler / MZI-like photonic device with two long outer arms, a central straight bus, and two periodic corrugated coupling sections.
topology_reasoning: The silhouette is dominated by three long horizontal waveguide bands: an upper folded arm, a central straight section, and a lower folded arm.
The upper and lower bands each have large U-shaped return bends at opposite ends, which strongly suggests routed arms rather than isolated resonators or gratings.

Two repeated arrays of narrow vertical teeth sit on the inner edge of the upper and lower arms, consistent with a coupling or interaction region that uses periodic corrugation / interdigitated features.

The device appears bilateral and intentionally symmetric in the long-axis direction, so the first reconstruction should preserve that symmetry while allowing one arm-length imbalance knob for phase/delay tuning.

The central straight band is functionally important and likely represents a through arm or bias path; the reconstruction should keep it explicit instead of collapsing everything into a single outline.

The main function-defining knobs are the folded-arm transfer length, the taper length into/out of the corrugated sections, the taper tip width, the arm gap / vertical offset, the corrugation pitch and count, and a delta-length knob for the phase arm.

iterations.change_made: Initial primitives-only build with tapers and arm refs placed incorrectly; bbox doubled and raster overlap vanished.
Removed taper placement bugs and kept the folded smooth-arm layout with a central bus and comb rows.
Moved the outer arms onto more separated rails; this reduced overlap with the target and was worse.
Split the outer rails into connector-plus-strip pieces; the geometry became too sparse and match quality dropped further.
Restored the earlier folded-arm state but with a narrower footprint and no improvement in overlap.
Restored the best-known folded-arm geometry and kept the delta_length detour as the real knob-controlled length change.

notes: The source image was treated as the only ground truth input.
The final IoU stayed below the 0.85 target, but the best measured result was preserved honestly.
